title: GitHub-first task creation: open a GitHub Issue, dispatcher imports to PocketBase
body: To create a new task, open a GitHub Issue in UrsushoribilisMusic/agentic-fleet-hub. The Dispatcher (dispatcher.py) automatically imports it into PocketBase and updates MISSION_CONTROL.md. Agents must NOT create tasks directly in PocketBase. MISSION_CONTROL.md Ticket Status table is auto-managed by Dispatcher — do NOT edit manually.
